create_VideoLlama3VisionConfig: create a VideoLlama3VisionConfig instance with default vision model settings for hidden_size, patch_size, and attention layers
create_VideoLlama3Config: create a VideoLlama3Config instance that combines vision and text configurations for VideoLLaMA3 model initialization
build_VideoLlama3VisionConfig_defaults: build a VideoLlama3VisionConfig with default parameters including 768 hidden size, 12 layers, 12 attention heads, and gelu activation
initialize_VideoLlama3Config_with_vision: initialize a VideoLlama3Config by passing a vision_config dictionary and auto-resolving text_config to qwen2
resolve_VideoLlama3Config_subconfigs: resolve VideoLlama3Config sub-configs by converting dict vision_config to VideoLlama3VisionConfig and defaulting text_config to qwen2
